rated_load_kg.basis: Typical 13-person traction lift; KONE publishes no rated-load field.

car_mass_kg.basis: Typical car mass for a 1000 kg lift.

counterweight_kg.basis: Car mass + 50% of rated load - standard balancing practice.

floors.basis: From the movement event's start/stop floors. KONE API field, recorded EXAMPLE value (schema is KONE's, value is illustrative). Recalibrates automatically once live credentials are configured.

floor_height_m.basis: distanceMeters / floors travelled. KONE API field, recorded EXAMPLE value (schema is KONE's, value is illustrative). Recalibrates automatically once live credentials are configured.

kg_per_person.basis: EN 81-20 passenger rating (75 kg per person).

max_load_kg.basis: Overload device trips at 110% of rated load (EN 81-20).

trips_per_day.basis: ISO 25745-2:2015 usage category 3 (table values from public summaries - unverified against the purchased text).

trip_duration_s.basis: Movement event durationSeconds. KONE API field, recorded EXAMPLE value (schema is KONE's, value is illustrative). Recalibrates automatically once live credentials are configured.

reference_load_kg.basis: Movement event loadPercentage x rated load - the load the design life is referenced to. KONE API field, recorded EXAMPLE value (schema is KONE's, value is illustrative). Recalibrates automatically once live credentials are configured.

load_spread_cv.basis: Per-trip load varies around the average (coefficient of variation 0.7): lifts run nearly empty and nearly full within a day.

service_interval_months.basis: The KONE service orders hold 1 preventive visit(s) - too few to derive an interval, so the simulation uses 6 months.

start_notes.service_count: Count of dated service orders for the equipment (lift-level, not per component).
start_notes.repair_count: Service orders of activityType REPAIR or CALLOUT.
start_notes.failure_history: Orders carrying an equipmentFailureReason, or an entrapment.
start_notes.days_since_last_service: Days since finishedDateTime of the most recent order (2026-07-14).
start_notes.inspection_score: Mapped from the ordinal equipmentConditionOnDeparture code. Four buckets cannot carry 0-100 resolution, and the code describes the LIFT, not this component.

notes.service_interval_months: The KONE service orders hold 1 preventive visit(s) - too few to derive an interval, so the simulation uses 6 months.
notes.callout_rate_per_month: The KONE service orders cover 6.5 months - under 12, too short to tell a fault rate from chance - so new faults come from the simulation's own wear-driven fault model.

reference.notice: No real KONE data exists in this build. Values marked kone_api come through the KONE API adapter, which currently replays recorded example responses; standards and physics are real; assumptions are stated. The simulation starts from the reference lift's KONE record and takes every rate KONE publishes from it; only what KONE does not publish (vibration, temperature, component age) is simulated. It is a model, not a record.

component_type.how: The four focus components of the reference lift: motor, steel ropes, sheave and overspeed governor.

material.how: Reference material per component; the KONE API publishes no material (see material grade).

component_age.how: Not in the KONE API (no installation date is published): simulated months since this part was installed (resets on replacement).

operating_hours.how: KONE movement durationSeconds per journey x the component's running-time share, at ISO 25745-2 trips/day (the KONE movement feed gives no journey count over time, so the trip rate is the standard's).

load_cycles.how: One cycle per KONE movement journey (RUN_COMPLETED) x the component's actuations per journey, at ISO 25745-2 trips/day (the KONE movement feed gives no journey count over time, so the trip rate is the standard's).

average_load.how: KONE movement loadPercentage x rated load is the default load; if you change the load, your value is used instead. Spread over trips and turned into each component's Miner-equivalent stress on its own rating scale.

vibration.how: Not in the KONE API: new-condition level rising with true wear and load, read at service visits with measurement noise.

temperature.how: Not in the KONE API: machine-room ambient (seasonal) + heat from load + wear, read at service visits.

service_count.how: Starts at the reference lift's 4 KONE service orders; then a visit every 6 months (assumption - too few KONE preventive visits to derive one).

repair_count.how: Starts at the reference lift's 2 KONE repair/callout orders; then callouts from the simulated fault model (KONE record too short for a rate).

failure_history.how: Starts at the reference lift's 2 KONE orders with a failure reason or entrapment; then simulated faults and breakdowns.

inspection_score.how: Starts at 90.0 - the KONE condition code on departure (lift-level); then graded at each simulated visit from true wear, with grading noise.

days_since_last_service.how: Starts at 72 days since the last KONE service order; then days since the last simulated visit.
